about: Limits for tools/perf/perf.js, the CI gate. The targets are the performance budget in views/atlas/README.md; the limits add headroom for slower CI machines. A step that fits in one frame measures about 16.7 ms (the time to the next frame), so medians near that are on budget and p90 is what catches stalls. Lower a limit when the page gets faster; raising one needs a reason in the PR.
